coffee.definition: A beverage consisting of an infusion of ground coffee beans.

tea.definition: A beverage made by steeping tea leaves in water.

hot-chocolate.definition: A warm, sweet beverage prepared by combining cocoa powder with milk and sugar.

espresso.definition: Strong black coffee brewed by forcing hot water under pressure through finely ground coffee beans.

cappuccino.definition: A coffee drink made with espresso, steamed milk, and a layer of milk foam.

latte.definition: A coffee drink made with espresso and a generous amount of steamed milk.

mocha.definition: A coffee drink made with espresso, chocolate, and milk.

herbal-tea.definition: A hot drink made by soaking herbs or other plant parts in water.

green-tea.definition: Tea produced by steeping minimally oxidized leaves of the tea plant, Camellia sinensis, in hot water, or the drink made this way.

chai.definition: Tea, often served in cafés as a spiced drink with milk.

water.definition: A liquid necessary for the life of most animals and plants.
water.exampleUsage: The water was identified during the lesson.

iced-tea.definition: Tea brewed with a strong flavor and poured over ice is called iced tea.

lemonade.definition: A cold sweet drink made with lemons, water, and sugar.

iced-coffee.definition: Coffee served cold, usually over ice.

milkshake.definition: Frothy drink of milk and flavoring and sometimes fruit or ice cream.

smoothie.definition: A thick drink made by blending fruit or vegetables, often with yogurt or milk.

slushie.definition: A thick cold drink made from crushed ice mixed with a sweet flavored liquid.
slushie.exampleUsage: She chose a strawberry slushie on the hot afternoon.

sparkling-water.definition: Water containing dissolved carbon dioxide fizzes and may gain its bubbles naturally or through artificial carbonation, without added sweeteners.

tonic-water.definition: A carbonated drink with a bitter flavor from quinine.

cold-brew.definition: Coffee or tea prepared by soaking it in cold water rather than brewing it with hot water.
cold-brew.exampleUsage: He ordered a cold brew with ice and milk.
cold-brew.arabicTranslation: قهوة أو شاي مُحضَّر بالنقع البارد

cranberry-juice.definition: A drink made from the juice of cranberries, usually with a tart taste.
cranberry-juice.exampleUsage: She poured cranberry juice into a glass with ice.

tomato-juice.definition: A liquid made from tomatoes and commonly packaged for sale in bottles or cans.

carrot-juice.definition: A beverage generally prepared by pressing fresh carrots to extract their liquid.

pineapple-juice.definition: A sweet, tangy drink made from the liquid pressed or extracted from pineapples.
pineapple-juice.exampleUsage: We served cold pineapple juice with breakfast.

mango-juice.definition: A sweet fruit drink made from mango flesh or juice.
mango-juice.exampleUsage: He drank mango juice with his lunch.

pomegranate-juice.definition: A red fruit drink made from the liquid inside pomegranate seeds.
pomegranate-juice.exampleUsage: Fresh pomegranate juice has a rich red color.

fresh-squeeze.definition: Freshly made fruit juice produced by pressing the fruit shortly before it is served.
fresh-squeeze.exampleUsage: The café serves a fresh squeeze made from oranges every morning.

soda.definition: A sweet drink containing carbonated water and flavoring.

cola.definition: Carbonated drink flavored with extract from kola nuts.

ginger-ale.definition: A carbonated soft drink flavored with ginger.
ginger-ale.exampleUsage: The glossary uses the term "Ginger Ale" in an educational description.

root-beer.definition: A sweet carbonated drink flavored with plant extracts, usually without alcohol.
root-beer.exampleUsage: The glossary uses the term "Root Beer" in an educational description.

cream-soda.definition: A sweet, carbonated beverage flavored with vanilla.

lemon-lime.definition: A citrus flavor or drink that combines the tastes of lemon and lime.
lemon-lime.exampleUsage: He chose a lemon-lime drink with his meal.
lemon-lime.arabicTranslation: نكهة أو مشروب الليمون والليمون الأخضر

energy-drink.definition: A drink that usually contains caffeine and is sold to increase alertness.

sports-drink.definition: A drink formulated to supply fluids, carbohydrates, or electrolytes during exercise.

kombucha.definition: A fermented drink made from sweetened tea with cultures of bacteria and yeast.
kombucha.exampleUsage: The café keeps bottles of kombucha in the refrigerator.

coconut-water.definition: The light-colored liquid naturally contained inside an unopened coconut.

beer.definition: A general name for alcoholic beverages made by fermenting a cereal (or mixture of cereals) flavored with hops.
beer.exampleUsage: The glossary uses the term "Beer" in an educational description.

wine.definition: An alcoholic drink made by fermenting grape juice or other fruit juice.
wine.exampleUsage: The glossary uses the term "Wine" in an educational description.

champagne.definition: A sparkling wine made in the Champagne region of France.
champagne.exampleUsage: The glossary uses the term "Champagne" in an educational description.

whiskey.definition: A liquor made from fermented mash of grain.
whiskey.exampleUsage: The glossary uses the term "Whiskey" in an educational description.

vodka.definition: Unaged colorless liquor originating in Russia.
vodka.exampleUsage: The glossary uses the term "Vodka" in an educational description.

gin.definition: A clear alcoholic spirit flavored mainly with juniper berries.
gin.exampleUsage: The glossary uses the term "Gin" in an educational description.

rum.definition: An alcoholic spirit made from sugarcane products such as molasses or sugarcane juice.
rum.exampleUsage: The glossary uses the term "Rum" in an educational description.

tequila.definition: Mexican liquor made from fermented juices of an agave plant.
tequila.exampleUsage: The glossary uses the term "Tequila" in an educational description.

brandy.definition: Distilled from wine or fermented fruit juice.
brandy.exampleUsage: The glossary uses the term "Brandy" in an educational description.

cocktail.exampleUsage: The glossary uses the term "Cocktail" in an educational description.
cocktail.definition: A mixed drink made with several ingredients, often including alcohol.
